question: In his autobiography, Babur described his interest in planning and laying out formal gardens, placed within rectangular walled enclosures and divided into four quarters by artificial channels. These gardens are known as ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chahar Bagh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Chahar Bagh** is a Persian-style garden layout where the space is divided into **four quarters** by water channels or pathways.
 
• The term **Chahar Bagh** translates to "**Four Gardens**" in Persian, symbolizing the **four gardens of paradise** as described in Islamic texts.
